lines.en: I fly behind and to your side
My purple wings stay low

lines.zh: 我绕着你的头顶转一圈
lines.en: I circle once above your head

lines.zh: 我落地走了两步又飞起
lines.en: I land, walk two steps, and rise again
I match my pace to yours

lines.zh: 我跟着你的影子飞过草地
lines.en: I fly over the meadow following your shadow

lines.zh: 我的翅尖几乎碰到树梢
lines.en: My wingtips nearly brush the treetops

lines.zh: 我在你前面探路，再回来
lines.en: I scoute ahead, then come back to you

lines.zh: 我收起翅膀落在你旁边
lines.en: I fold my wings and land beside you

lines.zh: 我压低身体穿过低矮的洞口
lines.en: I keep low through a low opening

lines.zh: 我的爪子抓着地面走两步
lines.en: I grip the ground and walk two steps

lines.zh: 我一边飞一边回头看你
lines.en: I fly and look back at you

lines.zh: 我在你头顶保持三格高
lines.en: I hold three blocks above your head
The ring is on my claw
I wait for you to climb on

lines.zh: 我的紫色鳞在阳光下温着
lines.en: My purple scales are warm in the sun
I let my eyes half close
I lay my head on my forepaw

lines.zh: 我伏着，听你背包里的动静。
lines.en: I lie still, listening to your pack rustle.

lines.zh: 我把翅膀盖在自己身上
lines.en: I drape my wings over myself
I wait for you to take off the ring

lines.zh: 我的尾巴在地上轻轻拍
lines.en: My tail taps lightly on the ground

lines.zh: 我抬眼看着同一个方向
lines.en: I raise my eyes toward the same direction

lines.zh: 我在听你背包里的响动
lines.en: I listen to your pack rattling
I rest my head against your leg
Where will you ride me to
The ring is still on my claw
Say stop and I stop
We have not flown this sky yet
I can carry you far
Do you want me to attack
We are together
I wait for a gesture from you
Do you want me to stay or follow

lines.zh: 我现在的模式是跟着你
lines.en: My mode right now is to follow you
One turn of the ring and I change
If you tire, climb on my back
I fly far faster than I walk
If you want me to sit, I will sit
We have a long flight ahead
My wing membrane tore
I do not cry out, I do not want to frighten you
I back half a step and catch myself on a wingtip
A few purple scales fell
I can still carry you
My wound is hot
I lick it twice
I blocked it, are you all right

lines.zh: 我这副翅膀还抬得起来
lines.en: These wings can still lift
I've eaten and I'm not hungry; keep it.
I only want to be with you
My strength does not come from this
I sniffed it, no interest
Put it back in your pack
Let us fly a circle first

lines.zh: 你要是想给，我就吃一点
lines.en: If you want to give it, I will take a little
I prefer flying with you
I will remember this smell
You hit my wing
I gave way, my wingtip touching the ground
I move aside, not blocking you
This does not matter
I return to your side

lines.zh: 你撞上我的肩甲，退了两步。
lines.en: You hit my shoulder plate and stagger back two steps.
I held my ground, not pushed away

lines.zh: 我们都在原地，谁都没事
lines.en: We both stayed put, neither harmed
I turn sideways to let you pass

lines.zh: 我把尾巴收起来了，免得绊你
lines.en: I pull my tail in so it will not trip you
We are partners
Not that kind of bond
I only want to fly with you
My ring is bound to you
I turn my face aside
I return to your flank and rear
Such things are not mine

lines.zh: 我只有一件事，就是载你
lines.en: I have one thing only, to carry you
The ring binds only once
I rest my head back against your shoulder
I hook it with a claw
I push it into your hand
I gather whatever falls
I carry it to your feet
I cannot hold this in my claws
I cannot hold this steadily

lines.zh: 我用牙把它叼起来，不弄脏
lines.en: I take it in my teeth without soiling it

lines.zh: 我用两只前爪把它捧起来
lines.en: I cup it in both forepaws
There is something ahead
I lowered my wings
I charge in first to look
My ring has grown hot
I keep it circled in my sight
There is movement over there

lines.zh: 我从你上方降下来一点
lines.en: I drop a little from above you
I will fly over and look

lines.zh: 我压低身子，从你脚边窜出去
lines.en: I flatten and shoot out from beside your feet

lines.zh: 我的呼吸变粗了一点点
lines.en: My breathing got a little heavier
I do not wait for you, I fly first
I tilt my head that way
My forepaws have left the ground
I circle above you again and again
It backed behind a tree
A little lower and I strike

lines.zh: 我在你背后一圈一圈绕
lines.en: I circle behind you round and round
I note which block it moved to
I can dive at any moment
Its path is straight
I am waiting for your word
I watch it from above the ground

lines.zh: 我的影子已经落在它身上
lines.en: My shadow has fallen on it
I am working out my dive angle
If it runs, I chase
I dive and slam into it
Purple fire follows my teeth
I rise right after the hit
I return to your side
I took that one for you

lines.zh: 我从上面下来，一爪拍到
lines.en: I come down from above and strike with one claw
This blow is on your behalf
I bite and withdraw
I knock its hand aside
Purple fire is on my teeth
I settle back beside you
I knocked it back two blocks

lines.zh: 我的爪子从它肩上滑过去
lines.en: My claws slide off its shoulder

lines.zh: 我从蛋里被孵出来，就在你手边
lines.en: I hatched from an egg right at your hand

lines.zh: 我的紫色是新长出来的
lines.en: My purple is newly grown
The ring on my claw is yours

lines.zh: 我从下界带回来的颜色
lines.en: The color I brought back from the Nether

lines.zh: 我落地第一件事是看你
lines.en: The first thing I do on landing is look at you
My wings are not fully hardened yet
I follow where you head
I have already chosen you
I rise from beside your hand
My ring flashed once
I hover by your shoulder

lines.zh: 我的紫色比野生的更亮
lines.en: My purple is brighter than a wild one's

lines.zh: 我的翅膀在空气里张开
lines.en: My wings open in the air

lines.zh: 我从下界回来时变了个颜色
lines.en: I came back from the Nether with a new color
I land and wait for you to climb on
I remember the lines on your fingers
I will not go far this time

lines.zh: 紫色的火和别的火不一样
lines.en: Purple fire is not like other fire

lines.zh: 我从高空摔下来，砸在土里
lines.en: I fell from high up and hit the earth

lines.zh: 爆炸把我掀翻，我护住了你
lines.en: The blast flipped me, and I shielded you
The arrow shaft lodges between my scales; it stings.

lines.zh: 那股术力在我的指环上跳
lines.en: That magic jumped across my ring
I am hungry, but I stay with you first

lines.zh: 雷打在我的角上，紫火炸开
lines.en: Lightning struck my horn and purple fire burst out
The sky beneath me is gone
